rubrics.justification: Accurately reflects a Day 5 expanded blastocyst consistent with 3BA, including B-grade ICM and A-grade TE; good detail on zona thinning and overall appearance, though some image-specific claims are slightly generic rather than strictly image-grounded.
Strong integration of age, tubal factor diagnosis, ovarian reserve, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, smoking, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, with a coherent link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor overstatement of smoking effect magnitude and embryo conversion quality slightly weaken precision.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice regarding morphology, prognosis, luteal support, and smoking cessation, but recommending routine fresh transfer from limited data and suggesting exercise restriction to reduce uterine contractions are not strongly guideline-based; PGT-A framing is somewhat simplistic.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, counseling, luteal support, and future planning, though some recommendations are somewhat generic and could be more individualized to cycle specifics.
